title: 自形浮雕 / Self relief
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party composition using existing attributed operators; outbound license pending

descriptions.en-US: Bend your image using its own softened brightness gradients. Bass pushes the relief and highs pull it back; edit the depth, sampling radius and edge smoothing.
descriptions.zh-CN: 用输入画面自身的柔化亮度梯度折射原图。低频推出浮雕、高频反向收回，可编辑深度、采样范围和边缘平滑。
